definition: Felony assaults on subway riders across the whole system: NYPD’s general assault and strangulation codes in the subway, excluding assaults on police and other public-service workers. Counts come from NYPD complaint records and run slightly below official totals.
notes: Systemwide, not by precinct: subway crime doesn’t follow precinct lines.
Ridership: MTA annual subway ridership (1.698 billion rides in 2019, 1.282 billion in 2025).
